lines.text: Keep me posted on the test results!

data.define: A way to ask someone to share new information.

example.text: Keep me posted on the test results!

misuse.text: Don't say 'keep me posted' if you ignore updates.

publish.title: What does "keep me posted" mean?
publish.value: Keep me posted = Tell me any updates. Example: "Keep me posted on the test results!" (casual English).
